description: Top holders of an ERC-20 token by cumulative net inflow USD. Returns wallet, net flow USD, volume USD, tx count, first/last seen dates, and known labels. Use when the user asks 'top holders of X' or 'who holds the most of token Y'. sort='flow' (default) ranks by cumulative net inflow USD, a flow and not a holding. sort='balance' ranks by the on-chain balanceOf among candidate wallets chosen by net inflow and by volume (a holder outside both is not in it) and adds balance, value_usd, supply_pct, balance_basis, balance_approximate and candidate_coverage to each row; balance_basis is 'chain' for a balance read from the chain ('unsupported' means the row is still ranked by flow, as for a chain's native coin), balance_approximate is true when a candidate's balance could not be read or the total supply is unknown, and candidate_coverage is the share of the total supply the candidates' balances add up to. sort='balance' is not available on every chain (the error names it). exclude_exchanges=true drops wallets labelled as an exchange.

exclude_exchanges.description: Drop wallets labelled as an exchange (default false)

sort.description: flow = cumulative net inflow USD (default); balance = on-chain balanceOf among candidate wallets
